claims.claim: Original Ambro Brother embroidery Sewing machine
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows AIG BROTHER, not Ambro Brother.

claims.claim: Japanese made, the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not stitch or may have mechanical failure.
risks.proof: A video of the machine running through its stitch length and tension settings.

risks.risk: The needle or presser foot may be damaged or worn.
risks.proof: A photo of the underside of the needle plate.

risks.risk: The machine may be missing essential accessories like the bobbin case or shuttle.
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the machine powered on and stitching fabric.
Photo of the underside of the needle plate to check for wear.
Photo of the bobbin area and the shuttle.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
